text:
Jules (Support): heads up — ArgoMaps is seeing 5xxs + massive cross-region latency. They say they were pinned to eu-west but requests time out and fall back to us-west. Customer impact: generation requests failing.

Anna (SRE): can you paste a couple of request IDs and the window? wondering if this is the probe failover we saw last week.

Jules (Support): ReqIDs: r-ff3c, r-ff4d, r-ff5a. Customer reported starts ~2026-09-14T08:10:30Z. Our router logs show fallback to us-west at 2026-09-14T08:11:23Z.

Mike (Eng Platform): quick hypothesis: eu-west health probe had a false-negative and router marked the pool unhealthy. I see probe timeouts and 502s from the probe side in the probe logs. Snippet: 
```
[08:10:55] probe/eu-west -> 502 Gateway
[08:11:01] probe/eu-west -> connect timeout
[08:11:05] router -> mark eu-west UNHEALTHY, start fallback -> us-west
```

Anna (SRE): also cross-check auth logs — a subset of requests show `401 invalid_sig` immediately before the failover. might be token rotation + cache mismatch hitting a small percentage of clients. Could amplify if router retries across regions.

Priya (Billing): flagged a cost spike for ArgoMaps at 08:11–08:18 UTC, roughly 3x their normal spend. Looks like they got routed to a Dedicated us-west pool (higher unit cost) during failover.

Jules (Support): Repro steps customer gave (simplified): 
```
curl -v -H "X-Region: eu-west" -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate"
# returns 503 / hangs for ~8s then the router falls back
```

Mike (Eng Platform): initial root cause indicators: (1) healthprobe agent version mismatch — we rolled probe agent 07:50 but NAT gateway egress IPs rotated at 08:05, so the probe traffic came from unexpected source IPs until the firewall rules reconciled. (2) firewall was still validating against an older CIDR set and dropped probe checks -> false negative.

Anna (SRE): mitigation applied: forced route-stickiness for customers tagged eu-sticky and temporarily disabled auto-fallback for eu-west for 15m to avoid oscillation while we fix probes.

ops-bot: deploy/rollback-check — deploy 2026-09-14T07:58Z detected; rollback candidate queued by Mike.

Mike (Eng Platform): immediate action items: 
- whitelist the rotated NAT egress CIDRs for probe egress (infra)
- restart probe agents in eu-west with the compatible certs (infra/sre)
- add tolerant failure window for probes so 2 transient timeouts don't mark unhealthy (runtime)
- create PR to make probe source IPs stable or advertise them to firewall (PR #2841)

Priya (Billing): we'll prepare a provisional credit for ArgoMaps; please provide exact impacted minutes and token counts.

Jules (Support): Customer accepted temporary workaround and asked for a postmortem + credit. I'll draft the customer message and attach logs + repro.

Anna (SRE): after infra whitelists nat CIDR and we restart probes, I'll kick an explicit healthcheck and watch for "healthy" events. If green, we'll re-enable fallback after 10m observation.

Mike (Eng Platform): follow-up: add probe logs to incident board, and I'll link the PR here once created. For support/ops: if you see any other customers pinned to eu-west getting routed to us-west, mention this thread. :thumbsup:

Jules (Support): noted. will keep thread updated and send customer-facing timeline once we have postmortem.
